description: Scripted scenarios for demo mode (npm run dev:demo). See demo/README.md for the format.

scenarios.name: Hello
scenarios.description: Plain text replies, including markdown rendering.

parts.text:
Hi! I'm the **Jarvis Bridge demo agent**. Every reply I send is scripted in `demo/demo-config.json`, so nothing here costs tokens and every run is identical.

Send me anything and I'll show off some markdown next.

Here's some markdown:

### A heading

- a bullet with `inline code`
- a [link](https://example.com)

| Column | Value |
| --- | --- |
| alpha | 1 |
| beta | 2 |

```ts
function greet(name: string): string {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}
```
That's the end of this scenario. Start a new chat to try another one.

scenarios.name: Tool calls
scenarios.description: Read / search / edit / execute tool calls, including a failing one.

parts.text: Let me look at the test first.

parts.name: Grep
parts.title: grep "function add"
parts.output: src/math.ts:1:export function add(a: number, b: number) { return a - b; }

parts.name: Bash
parts.title: npm test
parts.error:
AssertionError: Expected values to be strictly equal:

0 !== 4

    at src/math.test.ts:2:10

parts.text: Found it: `add` subtracts instead of adding. Fixing it now.

parts.name: Edit
parts.title: Edit src/math.ts
parts.output: The file src/math.ts has been updated.

parts.text: All tests pass now. The bug was a `-` that should have been a `+` in `src/math.ts`.
You're welcome! That's the end of this scenario.
